description: 30 Physics Form 4 calculation questions for live grading benchmark.

tests.label: Speed basic
tests.question: A car travels 120 km in 2 hours. Calculate the speed of the car. (1 mark)

tests.label: Speed wrong value
tests.question: A car travels 120 km in 2 hours. Calculate the speed of the car. (1 mark)

tests.label: Acceleration v=u+at full
tests.question: A motorcycle accelerates uniformly from 10 m s⁻¹ to 30 m s⁻¹ in 5 s. Calculate the acceleration. Show your working. (3 marks)

tests.label: Acceleration wrong final
tests.question: A motorcycle accelerates uniformly from 10 m s⁻¹ to 30 m s⁻¹ in 5 s. Calculate the acceleration. (3 marks)

tests.label: F=ma full
tests.question: Calculate the force acting on a 5 kg object when its acceleration is 3 m s⁻². (2 marks)

tests.label: F=ma final only
tests.question: Calculate the force acting on a 2 kg object when its acceleration is 4 m s⁻². (2 marks)

tests.label: Weight W=mg
tests.question: Calculate the weight of a 10 kg mass. [g = 10 m s⁻²] (2 marks)

tests.label: Pressure P=F/A
tests.question: A force of 200 N acts on an area of 0.5 m². Calculate the pressure. (2 marks)

tests.label: Work W=Fs
tests.question: Calculate the work done when a force of 50 N moves an object 4 m in the direction of the force. (2 marks)

tests.label: Power P=W/t
tests.question: A machine does 600 J of work in 12 s. Calculate the power of the machine. (2 marks)

tests.label: Density ρ=m/V
tests.question: Calculate the density of a substance of mass 240 g and volume 30 cm³. (2 marks)
tests.studentAnswer:
ρ = m / V
ρ = 240 / 30 = 8 g cm⁻³

tests.label: Ohm's law full
tests.question: Calculate the current flowing through a 12 Ω resistor when the potential difference is 24 V. (2 marks)

tests.label: Current wrong unit
tests.question: Calculate the current flowing through a 6 Ω resistor when the potential difference is 12 V. (1 mark)

tests.label: Heat Q=mcθ
tests.question: Calculate the heat required to raise the temperature of 2 kg of water by 5 °C. [c = 4200 J kg⁻¹ °C⁻¹] Show your working. (3 marks)

tests.label: Kinetic energy
tests.question: Calculate the kinetic energy of a 4 kg object moving at 3 m s⁻¹. (2 marks)

tests.label: Gravitational PE
tests.question: Calculate the potential energy gained when a 2 kg object is lifted 5 m vertically. [g = 10 m s⁻²] (2 marks)

tests.label: Momentum p=mv
tests.question: Calculate the momentum of a 0.5 kg ball moving at 12 m s⁻¹. (2 marks)
tests.studentAnswer:
p = mv
p = 0.5 × 12 = 6 kg m s⁻¹
